_note: Programs for U.S. college students, suggested on Profile under Demographic & Identity Information. No high school or admissions programs; professional networks students can join early are included; every entry must have a real logo. `for` tags: everyone, first_gen, black, hispanic_latino, asian, two_or_more, women_nonbinary, lgbtq. Optional `also`: every one of these must fit the student too; ignored by Show all. Optional `logo`: image URL from the organization's own site when its site icon isn't usable. Optional `tile`: dark background for white logos. Optional `localLogo`: a logo image bundled with the app (public/logos) when the site's icon is too small.
